release_notes: Three Ready Messages log refinements on top of 1.0.66. (1) The previous-incoming Ready is bold again, but stays at 10pt -- same size as plain/older lines (so the log doesn't stair-step), just bolder, plus the theme's dark accent color. 1.0.66's 10pt-normal recent2 was too quiet; bolding without bulking restores the 'still recent' visual cue. (2) Body column is left-aligned again. 1.0.65 had centered bodies on the widget's vertical midline; conventional left-aligned logs are easier to scan. The first tab stop is now 'left' at a small fixed indent (4px) and the right-tab math was updated from (center_x + max_body/2 + ts_width + gap) to (left_x + max_body + ts_width + gap). The persisted log format ('\tbody\t[ts]') is unchanged so existing logs replay correctly. (3) The thin gray separators between entries are darker -- a hardcoded neutral mid-gray (#9a9a9a) instead of the theme's pastel card_border (#dde6f5 on Modern Blue, #d4e4d5 on Sage Clinic, #fbc9d4 on Rose Quartz). The pastels were too faint to function as row dividers; neutral gray reads clearly on every theme without competing with accent colors.
